question: ______ countries participated in the Tokyo Paralympic 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**162**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games, which were actually held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic, saw participation from **162 National Paralympic Committees, including a refugee team.**
 
• **Avani Lekhara**: This Indian shooter made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win a gold medal at the Paralympics. She achieved this in the women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event, equaling the world record score of 249.6.
 
• **Sumit Antil**: In men's javelin throw F64, Antil not only won the gold medal but also set a new world record with his throw of 68.55 meters.
 
• **Manish Narwal**: In the mixed 50m pistol SH1 event, Narwal secured a gold medal with a Paralympic record of 218.2 points.
 
• **Krishna Nagar**: Competing in the Men's singles SH6 category in badminton, Nagar won gold for India.
 
• **Pramod Bhagat**: Another star in badminton, Bhagat won gold in men's singles SL3 event.
 
• **Singhraj Adana**: Winning a bronze in the P1 men's 10m air pistol SH1, Adana followed up with a silver in the P4 mixed 50m pistol SH1 event.
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu and Sharad Kumar**: In the men's high jump T42 category, Thangavelu and Kumar won silver and bronze for India respectively.
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia**: The veteran javelin thrower won silver in the men's javelin throw F46, which was his third Paralympic medal.
 
• **Sundar Singh Gurjar**: Along with Jhajharia in the men's javelin throw F46 category, Gurjar picked up a bronze medal.
